thread:
danielle: Hi folks — need help adding my 19yo stepdaughter to my health plan. She lives with me full-time now but is on a UK student visa and only has a UK passport. I have a temporary guardianship letter from the family court. Is that enough? Also worried about the timing relative to open enrollment.

maya_peopleops: Hi Danielle  that sounds like a Qualifying Life Event (gained dependent/change in household). Temporary guardianship + proof of residency (lease or school mail) usually works. We'll need documents translated if not in English. For relationship proof, a court guardianship order is acceptable.

benefits-bot: Reminder: Upload docs to Benefits Portal under "Manage Dependents" within 30 days of the QLE. Acceptable docs: court order, passport, visa page, school enrollment, utility/lease showing address. Certified translations required for non-English official docs.

danielle: Thanks. The guardianship doc is a scanned PDF from the UK court and is in English but uses some UK legal terms. Will that be fine? Also do we need her NHS card or anything else?

andre_hr: UK docs in English are fine. NHS card is optional; it's not required. Please upload the court order, a current utility or council tax bill listing her name or our shared address, and the university enrollment confirmation. If the council tax bill isn't available, a tenancy agreement with a move-in date helps.

samir_payroll: Payroll note: If she's added mid-month, deductions will be prorated. We can make the coverage effective back to the date the guardianship began if docs support it; otherwise effective date will be the 1st of next month. Also, if you want benefits premiums paid pretax we may need a TIN for certain tax forms later — we can onboard without it and follow up.

danielle: Got it. The guardianship start date is 2025-06-10. She left the UK for the summer and arrived here 2025-06-15. Which date do you recommend for the QLE?

maya_peopleops: Use the date she became a resident in your household (2025-06-15) for the QLE. Upload documents and note both dates in the case; we'll review for retro effective coverage.

danielle: Uploaded: court order, UK passport scan, tenancy agreement, and university acceptance letter to case #33421. I added a note about the summer travel.

benefits-bot: Automated: Case #33421 received. Docs queued for verification. Expected turnaround 5 business days. If translations or additional proofs are needed we'll flag the case.

andre_hr: Thanks Danielle  marking case "under review." If anything else is missing we'll request it here. If coverage is approved retro, benefits team will confirm open enrollment impact.

danielle: One more Q: If she loses student status next year, does coverage automatically stop or do I need to remove her?

maya_peopleops: Dependents who age out or lose student status must be removed per policy. We'll notify you ahead of the end-of-eligibility date and you can elect COBRA if eligible. We'll also send reminders before any change.

danielle: Perfect, appreciate the quick help :heart:
